Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Preline UI (https://preline.co/).

Component specification: Buttons 页有 Solid 预览和 Copy Code。

Visual details from source observation: 首页标题 Preline UI，顶栏 Update v5.0，命令 npm i preline，另链 Preline Pro。组件目录列出 Accordion、Alerts、Buttons。Buttons 页 Types 给出 Solid 预览与 Copy Code。LICENSE 为 MIT 加 Fair Use，禁止竞争产品；覆盖开源仓，不含 Pro。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
